appearance.subtle: Something shifts under the back of their coat.
appearance.obvious: Two thin jointed limbs unfold from beneath their shoulder blades and fold back again.
appearance.extreme: Six chitinous limbs arch from their back, each taller than they are. They are standing on four of them and using the others to hold three separate things.

description: Additional jointed limbs have unfolded from beneath your shoulder blades. They are not arms. They are better at some things than arms are.
drawbacks: Nothing goes over your back any more
name: Spider Limbs
